svg.title: Theta Plotter Top-Down Wiring Schematic
svg.desc: Clean top-down wiring schematic using separate orthogonal lanes for RP23CNC signals, TB6600 motor leads, and DIN power branches. X uses a shielded cable with white B- continuing to the motor blue lead; Y and A use stock blue B- leads.
svg.text: Theta Pen Plotter - Top-Down Wiring Schematic
Orthogonal routing keeps each signal, motor lead, and power branch in its own lane. Verify terminal silkscreen on the installed hardware.

g.text: One output pair per branch; top lanes are kept separate before the far-right drop.
Logical terminal locations; confirm final labels against board silkscreen.
Each axis G goes to a dedicated common block.
The block distributes G to PUL-, DIR-, and ENA-.
Local wiring is kept off this
12 V fused branch -> 6 V buck -> motor driver
12 V fused branch -> 5 V buck -> logic
HX711 mounts near the load cell.
Power corridor remains outside this block.
Every colored wire is drawn as a separate point-to-point lane; the clean layout is explanatory and does not change the electrical assignments.
Compare each terminal label with the silkscreen on the installed RP23CNC and TB6600 units before applying power.
Motor colors: X uses white for the shielded-cable B- conductor (to motor blue); Y/A use the stock blue B- conductor.
